source_title: India On Japan’s Missile Map: Why Tokyo Wants to Test Its 1,000-Km Missiles On Indian Ranges - The Times of India
source_excerpt: India could become Japanâs new training ground for long-range weapons. Japanese officials have reportedly travelled to India to examine missile ranges and defence facilities. The focus is on the Type 25 anti-ship missile, which has an estimated range of around 1,000 kilometres, along with small attack drones. Japan has previously conducted missile drills with the United States and Australia. India could become the next major partner. The logic is practical. Japan needs space, maritime safety zones and controlled airspace to train effectively. India has all three in greater abundance. The arrangement is not final. But the strategic implications are already visible. A Japanese missile tested in India would mark a new phase in Indo-Pacific defence cooperation.
